# scc_compliance_custodian (Resource)

Manages the ComplianceCustodian object via New-ComplianceCustodian / Get-ComplianceCustodian / Set-ComplianceCustodian / Remove-ComplianceCustodian.

## Schema

- `share_point_location` (Set of String) Maps to the -SharePointLocation parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `identity` (String) Identity used to target the object in cmdlets.
